metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Trade & Fleet Engine Services | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Specialist engine rebuild and replacement services for Mercedes-Benz trade and fleet customers. Fast-tracked assessments, volume pricing, and minimal downtime for commercial vehicles.
lede: Dedicated engine rebuild and replacement solutions for fleet operators and trade customers. We understand downtime costs – our services are designed for speed, reliability, and predictable budgeting.

sections.heading: How Our Trade & Fleet Service Differs

blocks.html: Retail and fleet engine services share the same technical excellence, but fleet operators have distinct needs. We tailor our approach to meet the specific demands of commercial vehicle operations.

blocks.note: We handle multiple vehicles, from small fleets of 5 to large mixed fleets of 50+ vans and trucks. Our workshop capacity is planned to accommodate batch jobs without compromising quality.
Every day your vehicle is off the road costs money. We prioritise fleet bookings with fast-tracked assessments, expedited parts sourcing, and dedicated technicians to minimise disruption.
We offer fixed-price quotes per vehicle, volume pricing agreements, and clear delivery schedules. No hidden costs – just transparent, predictable budgeting for your fleet operations.
We build lasting relationships based on consistent quality, clear communication, and proactive support. Our fleet clients benefit from priority service and customised reporting.

blocks.html: We also provide [on-site engine assessments](/mercedes-engine-inspection-assessment) for large fleets, and we offer dedicated collection and delivery for vehicles within the UK.

items: **Fast-tracked assessment** – We prioritise fleet vehicles for inspection, often completing the diagnosis within 24 hours of arrival.
**Volume pricing & service agreements** – Competitive rates for multiple vehicles, with flexible contract terms tailored to your usage.
**Priority scheduling** – Commercial vehicles (Sprinters, Vitos, V-Classes, Citans) are given dedicated bay time.
**Customised reporting** – We provide detailed rebuild/replacement reports, including parts replaced, machining details, and maintenance recommendations for your fleet records.
**Dedicated fleet liaison** – A single point of contact for all your vehicles, ensuring seamless communication and progress updates.

blocks.html: Pricing is quoted per vehicle based on the engine type and required work. We offer volume discounts and fixed-rate agreements for regular fleet clients. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer)
Images are staged in our workshop using real premises as reference. Real fleet job photography coming soon.
We cover the full range of Mercedes-Benz commercial vehicles used in fleets across the UK. Most common are the Sprinter, Vito, V-Class, and Citan, with a variety of diesel and petrol engine options.

We also work on older models like the [M-Class](/mercedes-m-class-engines) and [GLK](/mercedes-glk-class-engines) if they are part of your fleet. For a full list, see our [engine rebuild](/mercedes-engine-rebuild) and [replacement](/mercedes-engine-replacement) service pages. Engine families we service on these vehicles include the [OM651](/mercedes-om651-engine), [OM642](/mercedes-om642-engine), [OM654](/mercedes-om654-engine), and [OM607](/mercedes-om607-engine) diesel units.

steps.title: Fleet Consultation
steps.body: We discuss your fleet size, vehicle types, and service requirements. We agree on a service level, pricing structure, and scheduling framework.

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Inspection
steps.body: Vehicles are booked into our dedicated fleet bays. We carry out a thorough engine inspection and provide a fixed-price quote per vehicle.

steps.title: Authorisation & Work
steps.body: With your approval, we proceed with the agreed work – rebuild or replacement – following the same factory-grade procedures we use for all Mercedes engines.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.body: Every engine is tested on our stand or in-vehicle, with Xentry diagnostics. We ensure each unit meets factory performance standards.

steps.title: Fleet Reporting
steps.body: We provide a comprehensive report for each vehicle, including parts replaced, labour time, and service recommendations for future maintenance.

steps.title: Ongoing Support
steps.body: We offer 12-month unlimited-mileage warranties on all work, with a dedicated fleet liaison for any follow-up questions or additional bookings.

sections.heading: Why Fleet Operators Choose Mercedes Garage

items: **Commercial vehicle specialists** – Our technicians have extensive experience with Sprinter, Vito, V-Class, and Citan engines, including OM651, OM642, and OM654 units.
**Dedicated fleet bays** – We have workshop capacity to handle multiple vehicles simultaneously, reducing overall downtime.
**Transparent fixed pricing** – No hourly rate surprises; we quote per job and offer volume discounts for regular fleet work.
**Nationwide recovery** – We can collect vehicles from anywhere in the UK (from £70) and return them after repair.
**Comprehensive reporting** – Detailed job sheets and maintenance logs to help you track fleet health and plan future services.
**12-month warranty** – All rebuilds and replacements come with our unlimited-mileage warranty, giving you complete confidence.

steps.body: Contact our fleet team via phone, email, or the registration lookup to discuss your requirements.
We arrange a schedule and provide fixed-price quotes for each vehicle.
We carry out the work in our dedicated fleet bays, with regular progress updates.
We return your vehicles with comprehensive reports and a 12-month warranty.

blocks.html: Need help managing a fleet emergency? [Contact our fleet liaison team](/contact) for immediate support.

items.q: Do you offer volume discounts for multiple vehicles?
items.a: Yes – we provide tailored pricing for fleets of 3 or more vehicles. Contact our fleet team to discuss your specific needs and receive a custom quote.

items.q: How quickly can you turn around a fleet engine repair?
items.a: We prioritise fleet vehicles. Typical turnaround for a rebuild is 3-5 working days, and a replacement can be completed in 2-3 days. We can expedite for urgent cases.

items.q: Can you collect and return vehicles from our depot?
items.a: Yes – we offer nationwide recovery for all fleet vehicles, with collection usually within a few hours of booking. We can arrange collection and return as part of a service agreement.

items.q: Do you provide fleet maintenance records?
items.a: Absolutely. We provide detailed reports for each vehicle, including all work performed, parts used, and recommendations for future service intervals.

items.q: Do you cover all Mercedes commercial models?
items.a: Yes – from Sprinter and Vito to V-Class and Citan, and even older M-Class and GLK if they are in your fleet. We also handle petrol and diesel configurations across all years.
